newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE MARKET NOT WELL TESTED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE MARKET NOT WELL TESTED - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said.

Inquiry was moderate and demandlight. Sales confirmed on 300 slaughter steers and 600 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 70,200 head including 41,200 head or about 59 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1325 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1125
